title: Bind one value
summary: Erlang: Bind one value. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: Variables start with a capital letter. A variable can be bound only once in a function call.

blocks.text: Save each example as lesson.erl. Run erlc lesson.erl, then erl -noshell -s lesson main -s init stop. The file name must match the module name.
Pencils binds to 3. The argument list gives its sum with 2 to the ~p slot.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Matching a bound variable to a different value causes an error.
